trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0. The initial rollback command halted partway through due to an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 and us-west/eu-west still on v2.3.1; the rollback was completed by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions. All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy (error rate 0.2%). Note: v2.3.1 and the v2.3.1-rc staging deploy both reported unhealthy status; investigate the cause before attempting to redeploy v2.3.1.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Incident:** checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Checked deployment history and confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0 — the orchestrator errored partway through, leaving us-east rolled back but us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1.
3. Completed the rollback by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions.
4. Verified final state: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.
5. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api. The initial incident creation call timed out, but I verified via the incident list that it was actually created successfully before doing anything else — no duplicate exists.

**Follow-up note (recorded in the incident):** Both v2.3.1 (production) and v2.3.1-rc (staging) reported unhealthy status, so the root cause should be investigated before attempting to redeploy v2.3.1.
